title: Restart the airp app
detail: A new version is installed (long-term picks page, run history, the fact sheet the judge read). It shows after a restart.

title: Google Cloud project ID for the news archive
detail: The news download for the research test takes about 350 more hours the slow way. With a free BigQuery project it takes minutes. Free tier only; every query is checked for cost first.

title: How to score a long-term pick that stops trading
detail: If a pick is bought out or delisted before its 3 months are up, its cohort cannot be scored today. Usual practice: count it at its last traded price. Needed before the first cohort closes (about 30 Dec).

title: Reports published while the PC is off for more than 3 days
detail: They are not written into the ledger as missed (the daily check does alert on the missing runs). Small, but the count of missed decisions would be too low after a long outage.

title: What the broker account should do if the 2.5x book is ever wiped out
detail: The paper book would close, but its positions at the broker would stay open because the mirror only follows new targets. Practice money only; needs a rule.

title: Test a clean install (downloads Python packages)
detail: The package list was incomplete and is now fixed and pinned. Proving it on a fresh environment means downloading the packages again (roughly 1 to 2 GB, free). Downloads need your OK.

title: Rebuild how the runner reports its steps
detail: Today alerts are found by reading each step's printed text. The outside review recommends each step returning a small status record instead. It touches every scheduled job, so I would do it on a weekend with rehearsals, not during earnings season without your yes.

title: Check the extraction benchmark's hand labels
detail: 12 hard releases, 65 figures (revenue, EPS, adjusted EPS, quarter end, guidance), labelled by Claude from each press release's text; a figure that was not read is left out. An hour of your eyes on backend/benchmarks/extraction/gold.json makes it checked by a person, which is what the outside review asked for.

title: A judge answer with no usable probability stops the run
detail: If Bonsai's answer for one release cannot be turned into log-odds (neither BUY nor PASS among its likely first words), the runner fails the whole run, and every run after it for 3 days, because the answer is cached. Since 1 Oct the other releases' decisions are already written when that happens, so no decision is lost, but outcomes and the run record are not written and each run alerts. It has not happened live. Recommended: log that one release as missed ('no decision'), as for a release without a press release. It changes the frozen runner, so it needs your yes.

title: Research tools still read the SEC list's acceptance time
detail: The live runner now takes each release's acceptance time from the filing's own page, because the SEC's list was 4 hours early or late for 7 of 20 filings checked. The research agents' as-of guard (app/tools/asof.py) and the 8-K history builder (scripts/build_8k_events.py) still read the list. A research agent could see, or be denied, a filing within a few hours of its cut-off. No live decision depends on them. Recommended: the same fix there, registered as a change to the research arms' inputs.

title: Put the new records in the app
detail: The funnel, the account view, the AI-contribution report, stage timings and the evidence files are written to results/forward/ but the desktop app does not show them yet. Say if you want them on a page (a new app version, shown after a restart).
